items.name: Declare an array
items.description: Declares an integer array reference — no memory allocated yet.

items.name: Declare and allocate
items.description: Creates an array of size 5. All elements default to 0.

items.name: Declare with values
items.description: Inline initialization — size is inferred automatically.

items.name: 2D array
items.description: 3 rows, 4 columns. Each cell defaults to 0.

items.name: 2D with values
items.description: Inline 2D initialization.

items.name: Get element by index
items.description: 0-based indexing. Throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException if out of range.

items.name: Set element
items.description: Assign a value to a specific index.

items.name: Array length
items.description: length is a field, not a method — no parentheses.

items.name: For loop (indexed)
items.description: Classic loop — use when you need the index.

items.name: Enhanced for loop
items.description: Simpler syntax — can't modify elements by index.

items.name: Traverse 2D array
items.description: Nested loops for 2D traversal.

items.name: Sort ascending
items.description: In-place sort using Dual-Pivot Quicksort. Time: O(n log n).

items.name: Sort a range
items.description: Sort from index 1 (inclusive) to 4 (exclusive).

items.name: Sort descending (Integer[])
items.description: Works only on Integer[] (not int[]). Needs Collections import.

items.name: Binary search
items.description: Array must be sorted first. Returns index, or negative if not found.

items.name: Fill with value
items.description: Sets every element to the given value.

items.name: Copy full array
items.description: Returns a new array. If new length > original, pads with 0.

items.name: Copy a range
items.description: Copies index 1, 2, 3 (end index is exclusive).

items.name: Check equality
items.description: Returns true if same length and all elements match.

items.name: Print array
items.description: Outputs [10, 20, 30] — essential for debugging.

items.name: Print 2D array
items.description: Outputs nested like [[1,2],[3,4]].

items.name: Find max element
items.description: Linear scan O(n) — always initialize with arr[0], not 0.

items.name: Reverse in-place
items.description: Two-pointer swap — O(n) time, O(1) space.

items.name: Two-pointer template
items.description: Used in pair-sum, container with most water, palindrome, etc.

items.name: Prefix sum
items.description: Precompute cumulative sums. Range query in O(1) after O(n) build.

items.name: Sliding window (fixed size)
items.description: O(n) instead of O(n·k) for fixed window aggregation.

items.name: Frequency map
items.description: Count occurrences. Used in duplicates, majority element, anagrams.
